title: sutra_pr_risk — branch risk profile
description:
Composite risk score (0.0–1.0) for a branch/PR — fuses blast radius, complexity delta, churn, and change volume into a single number with breakdown.

Same shape as `sutra_file_health` but at branch scope. Every input already exists via `sutra_diff_impact`, `sutra_file_health`, `sutra_hotspots`.

Tool shape: `sutra_pr_risk(base, head)` → score, per-signal breakdown, top-N riskiest changed symbols, recommendations.

See docs/feature-ideas.md → "sutra_pr_risk".

**Independent of other simple-additions tasks.**

acceptance_criteria.text: Per-signal breakdown (blast_radius, complexity_delta, churn, volume) included
Top-N riskiest changed symbols listed with their individual scores
Documented weight choices (rationale, not just numbers)

messages.author: agent
